metadata.short_desc: A SillyTavern-style chat WebUI for AstrBot: dual entry, streaming replies, persona picker.
metadata.desc: Provides a SillyTavern-style chat view inside AstrBot WebUI with persona selection, streaming replies, reasoning & tool-call display and attachments, via an embedded Plugin View and a standalone port page. Talks to the provider directly and manages personas/history itself.
